title: Setback from the boundary to achieve the 2.7, 3.3, 3.5 and 4.1 Objectives
text: A 2.4.2 Development is setback from the boundary in order to achieve the Objectives outlined in 2.7 Building separation, 3.3 Tree canopy and deep soil areas, 3.5 Visual privacy and 4.1 Solar and daylight access.
notes: Cross-reference to other elements' Objectives; judgment. New DG 2.4.5 and 2.4.9 support build-to-boundary and reduced setbacks next to non-residential land (C4P2-071).
